remark: Added a try-catch block that catches NumberFormatException and IndexOutOfBoundsException around the cue processing (from timestamp parsing to cue creation). NumberFormatException may be thrown by parseTimestampUs if the timestamp string is malformed. IndexOutOfBoundsException may be thrown by matcher.group if the pattern lacks capturing groups. If an exception is caught, a warning is logged, remaining lines of the current cue are skipped (until an empty line), and the loop continues to the next cue. analysis: The code snippet parses WebVTT subtitles from an InputStream. The execution flow: read header, skip to empty line, then loop: read line, skip comments, check for cue header, parse timestamps and settings, read text lines, create cue, add to list. Potential runtime exceptions: 1) IndexOutOfBoundsException from matcher.group(1), (2), (3) if pattern CUE_HEADER lacks groups; 2) NumberFormatException from parseTimestampUs when timestamp is malformed; 3) IndexOutOfBoundsException from parsePositionAttribute (inside settings loop but not caught). The existing try-catch only handles NumberFormatException in the settings loop, leaving other runtime exceptions uncaught. To improve robustness, a single try-catch should wrap the entire cue processing block after the CUE_HEADER match, catching NumberFormatException and IndexOutOfBoundsException, logging a warning, skipping the rest of the cue lines, and continuing to the next cue.
